Retained statement: A new texture slicing system has been implemented that allows a single Texture object to render a grid of nine sub-textures without distortion at the corners. The edges and central fill of the rendered texture can be configured to either tile or stretch across their respective dimensions.

Retained statement: This system is recommended to be used in new code going forward as a replacement for both the deprecated Backdrop system and the script-based NineSlice panel layout utility. One of the advantages of this new system is that it only requires a single texture object to render the grid, whereas both the old systems required nine separate objects. This system is fully compatible with custom texture assets and does not require the use of atlases.
